name: tidegap
description: Auto-dispatch "do it later" work. Invoke whenever the user signals deferral: "do this later", "by tomorrow", "tonight", "overnight", "by EOD", "sometime this week", "when you have a moment", "remind me to", "queue this up", "schedule this", "no rush". The plugin's /tidegap:defer command queues the task to dispatch at the cleanest electricity-grid hour inside the deadline — lower carbon than running now, Anthropic/OpenAI Batch APIs at 50% of sync list price (projected), auditable carbon receipt. Full CRUD via 10 commands. Persistent SQLite queue at ~/.tidegap/queue.db. Auto-wires the @tidegap/mcp MCP server.
